Scenario PAWK-171 - Le collaborateur reçoit une notification quand son rôle est modifié
Steps
# Given: Un administrateur modifie le rôle du collaborateur
Given path '/api/v1/users/' + collabId 0.000
And header Authorization = 'Bearer ' + adminToken 0.000
And request { roleId: 2 } 0.000
When method put 0.000
Then status 200 0.000
* match response.data.roleName == 'Manager' 0.000
# Cleanup: restaurer le rôle d'origine
Given path '/api/v1/users/' + collabId 0.000
And header Authorization = 'Bearer ' + adminToken 0.000
And request { roleId: 3 } 0.000
When method put 0.000
Then status 200 0.000
* match response.data.roleName == 'Collaborator' 0.000
# When: Le collaborateur consulte ses notifications (nouvelle connexion pour éviter un token périmé)
* def collab = call read('classpath:zenity/ofintra/common/login-helper.feature') { email: '#(collabEmail)', password: '#(collabPassword)' } 0.000
* def collabToken = collab.accessToken 0.000
Given path '/api/v1/notifications' 0.000
And header Authorization = 'Bearer ' + collabToken 0.000
When method get 0.000
Then status 200 0.000
* match response.success == true 0.000
# Then: La notification la plus récente concerne le changement de rôle, non lue, destinée au collaborateur
* def notifications = response.data 0.000
* assert notifications.length > 0 0.000
* def latest = notifications[0] 0.000
* match latest.userId == parseInt(collabId) 0.000
* match latest.read == false 0.000
* def latestText = ((latest.title || '') + ' ' + (latest.message || '')).toLowerCase() 0.000
* def mentionsRoleChange = latestText.includes('rôle') || latestText.includes('role') 0.000
* assert mentionsRoleChange == true 0.000

Scenario PAWK-574 - Un administrateur peut bloquer un collaborateur actif et ce collaborateur ne peut plus se connecter
Steps
# Verify the user is ACTIVE
* def getUser = call read('classpath:zenity/ofintra/common/get-user-by-id.feature') {userId: '#(collabId)', token: '#(adminToken)'} 0.000
* match getUser.response.data.status == 'ACTIVE' 0.000
# When: L'administrateur bloque le collaborateur
* def blockUser = call read('classpath:zenity/ofintra/features/users/helpers/block-user.feature') {userId: '#(collabId)', token: '#(adminToken)'} 0.000
* match blockUser.response.success == true 0.000
* def getBlockedUser = call read('classpath:zenity/ofintra/common/get-user-by-id.feature') {userId: '#(collabId)', token: '#(adminToken)'} 0.000
* match getBlockedUser.response.data.status == 'BLOCKED' 0.000
# Then: La tentative de connexion du collaborateur bloqué est rejetée
Given path '/api/v1/auth/login' 0.000
And request { email: '#(collabEmail)', password: '#(collabPassword)' } 0.000
When method post 0.000
Then status 403 0.000
And match response.success == false 0.000
And match response.message == '#string' 0.000
* assert response.message.toLowerCase().contains('bloqué') || response.message.toLowerCase().contains('blocked') || response.message.toLowerCase().contains('désactivé') 0.000
# Cleanup: Réactiver le collaborateur pour les prochains tests
* karate.call('classpath:zenity/ofintra/features/users/helpers/reactivate-user.feature', { userId: collabId, token: adminToken }) 0.000

* assert registrationSuccess 0.000

And param page = 0 0.000
And param size = 20 0.000
When method get 0.000
Then status 200 0.000
* def historyContent = response.content 0.000
* assert historyContent.length > 0 0.000
# And: elle doit contenir l'identifiant de l'utilisateur créateur
* def creationLog = historyContent[0] 0.000
* match creationLog.entityType == 'USER' 0.000
* match creationLog.entityId == createdUserId 0.000
* match creationLog.actionType == 'REGISTERED' 0.000
* match creationLog.performedById == adminId 0.000
* match creationLog.performedByName == '#notnull' 0.000
* match creationLog.performedByEmail == '#notnull' 0.000
* match creationLog.targetUserId == createdUserId 0.000
* match creationLog.performedAt == '#notnull' 0.000
